# CodeSpeedTest

> A free coding speed test platform for developers to measure WPM, code accuracy, and typing proficiency across 500+ programming languages.

CodeSpeedTest helps developers improve their coding speed and accuracy through interactive speed tests, daily challenges, and comprehensive language support. The platform tracks metrics like Net WPM, syntax accuracy, and muscle memory development across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C++, Rust, Go, and many other languages.

## Core Testing Tools

- [Coding Speed Typing Test](https://codespeedtest.com/coding-speed-typing-test): Main coding speed typing test measuring WPM and code accuracy
- [Code Accuracy Test](https://codespeedtest.com/code-accuracy): Code accuracy test with real-time feedback and syntax WPM metrics
- [Programming Syntax WPM Calculator](https://codespeedtest.com/programming-syntax-wpm): Programming syntax WPM calculator with code accuracy and real-time feedback
